title: PBMC high PRS pair 1
treatment_protocol_ch1: Subjects were environmentally exposed to ambient PM2.5. No in vitro treatment was administered. Matching was based on high vs. low PM2.5 sensitivity polygenic risk scores (sPRS) and real-world air pollution exposure.
growth_protocol_ch1: Not applicable. PBMCs were isolated directly from peripheral blood of pediatric asthma patients; no in vitro culture was performed.
extract_protocol_ch1: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were isolated from whole blood using density gradient centrifugation. Single-cell suspensions were prepared and viability was assessed before library preparation. RNA was extracted as part of the single-cell 10x Genomics workflow.

Single-cell RNA libraries were constructed using the 10x Genomics Chromium Single Cell 3' v3.1 kit, following the manufacturer's protocol. Libraries were barcoded, amplified, and pooled for sequencing.
description: Library name: JelteKelchtermans-20241217-GEX-1-H1
PBMCs collected from a pediatric asthma patient with high PM2.5 sPRS
data_processing: Raw sequencing reads were processed using Cell Ranger (10x Genomics) for alignment, filtering, and UMI counting.
Reads were aligned to the human reference genome using STAR within Cell Ranger.
Quality control filtering was applied to remove low-quality cells and doublets.
Cell-type annotation was performed using SingleR with the celldex::DatabaseImmuneCellExpressionData() reference.

Pseudobulk gene expression matrices were generated by aggregating counts per cell type per individual. Differential expression was assessed using the Wilcoxon rank-sum test, with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction.
Assembly: GRCh38/hg38

Supplementary files format and content: For each sample, processed data include Cell Ranger-generated output files: barcodes.tsv.gz: contains the list of cell barcodes; features.tsv.gz: lists gene identifiers and annotations; matrix.mtx.gz: sparse matrix of UMI counts for each gene-cell pair
Supplementary files format and content: These files represent the filtered gene expression matrix for each individual sample in 10x Genomics format.

Pseudobulk gene expression matrices were generated by aggregating counts per cell type per individual. Differential expression was assessed using the Wilcoxon rank-sum test, with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction.
Assembly: GRCh38/hg38

Supplementary files format and content: For each sample, processed data include Cell Ranger-generated output files: barcodes.tsv.gz: contains the list of cell barcodes; features.tsv.gz: lists gene identifiers and annotations; matrix.mtx.gz: sparse matrix of UMI counts for each gene-cell pair
Supplementary files format and content: These files represent the filtered gene expression matrix for each individual sample in 10x Genomics format.

metadata.exposure: ambient PM2.5; no in vitro treatment
